milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the chiseled_red_sandstone entrance arch at spawn-relative (0, 1, -3) and face it. The chiseled_red_sandstone blocks are placed at the entrance gateway at ~0,~0-1,~-3. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the block.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate deeper into the structure to the inner room and face the cut_red_sandstone_slab blocks placed at spawn-relative (7, 0, -17). These slabs are on the floor of the back room at ~6-8, ~0, ~-17. max_distance=16 allows detection from within the structure, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the slabs.
